name: ISIS-Somalia in Puntland
started: 2024-12-01 (approximate; Puntland's Operation Hilaac in the Cal Miskaad mountains)
summary: The Islamic State's Somali branch, based in the Cal Miskaad mountains of Puntland's Bari region, was cut down by Puntland's Operation Hilaac in 2025 with heavy US air support but still holds mountain villages.

sides.name: Puntland and partners
backers: United States (air strikes and basing; base expansion deal 2 Aug 2026)

sides.name: Islamic State Somalia Province
members: ISIS-Somalia (about half foreign fighters by 2024, Ethiopians the largest group)
sides.strength: 600 to 700 in 2024 (UN Security Council), falling to an estimated 100 to 200 by mid-2025 (Wikipedia infobox).

background: ISIS-Somalia formed in 2015 when Abdul Qadir Mumin broke from al-Shabaab. It grew into a financial hub for the Islamic State's African branches. Puntland launched Operation Hilaac around the turn of 2025 and captured numerous bases.
It matters beyond its size because it moves money and foreign fighters for the wider Islamic State network, and because Puntland's campaign is a key reason the US is expanding its Bosaso base.
year: Puntland forces removed the group from around Bosaso in 2025 but it still controls villages in the nearby mountains. In August 2026 the US and Puntland agreed to expand the US base in Bosaso. CTP reports Houthi weapons smuggling reaching ISIS-Somalia.
situation: As of late 2026 ISIS-Somalia is much reduced, holding villages in the Cal Miskaad range, with Puntland and US forces continuing operations.
technical: Strength fell from 600 to 700 (UN, 2024) to an estimated 100 to 200 (mid-2025).
About half of members were foreign by 2024, with Ethiopians the largest single nationality, plus Sudanese, Yemenis, Egyptians and Djiboutians (Wikipedia, citing UN and press reporting).
Puntland's Operation Hilaac captured numerous ISIS bases in the Bari mountains by 11 Jan 2025; the group was pushed out of the Bosaso area during 2025 but kept mountain villages.
Houthi weapons smuggling to ISIS-Somalia via Eritrea and Sudan has been reported (CTP, Aug 2026).
Financing: protection money in Bosaso, illegal gold mining in Cal Miskaad under investigation, and earlier cryptocurrency transfers to ISKP of about $25,000 a month (UN, 2023).
US basing at Bosaso is being expanded under a 2 Aug 2026 agreement with Puntland.

US strikes continue: AFRICOM struck ISIS-Somalia in the Golis Mountains about 75 km southeast of Bosaso on 6 May 2026; strikes reported on 22 Apr (Cal Miskaad) and 21 May (near Qandala) were denied by AFRICOM, a reminder that several countries fly strikes in Somalia (New America).
casualties: No reliable figures for the review period.

timeline.event: Puntland reports capture of numerous ISIS bases in Operation Hilaac.
US and Puntland sign agreement to expand the Bosaso base.

outlook: Watch whether ISIS-Somalia rebuilds through foreign recruits and smuggling, and how US basing at Bosaso evolves.

zones.name: Cal Miskaad mountains (approx)
zones.note: ISIS-Somalia's remaining mountain villages in Bari region.

sources.label: New America: AFRICOM confirms 63 strikes in Somalia in 2026 (29 May 2026)
